mutationPerformed.meaning: The handler reports no mutation for this read.

result.meaning: Present after a successful nmcli read.

lineCount.meaning: Number of retained entries, at most 256.

entries.meaning: Retained Wi-Fi connection rows, split on colon and trimmed; at most four fields per row.

first_missing_signal.meaning: Present on handler refusal or nmcli failure. The enum lists fixed tokens; gate admission may also forward protocol-kernel-definition-missing:<index> and protocol-kernel-field-missing:<field> as open forms.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Present on an early refusal or blocking-task failure; nmcli failures are instead carried in first_missing_signal. The enum lists fixed tokens; gate admission can also forward protocol-kernel-definition-missing:<index> and protocol-kernel-field-missing:<field> when the loaded kernel declaration is invalid.
